Bots with only pistols buy just a rifle - another pistol pushed one out over the firearm limit, stopped only by chance. With spare money a defuse kit comes before a backpack - the backpack left too little for the kit.

A disabled fog of war (angle 0 or 360) stays disabled at the screen edge - narrowed, 360 turned into an enabled 30 degree cone, so a bot looking far on a map without fog saw a thin wedge. FieldOfView tests cover it, the thresholds follow the balance params instead of fixed numbers, and the difficulty test checks the order of the multipliers. Dead #if 0 in world_camera removed.

"Pickup swaps wielded firearm" is in Controls - Inventory with a tooltip on what ON and OFF swap, not among the mouse settings. The datum gun's shot frames have the same back_anchor as its base sprite. The aimed throw's comment names b2_maxTranslation as a per-body limit.

Fixes after the back weapons audit - inventory and shop. Items stowed in the same step fall out of the deposit in the order of their ids, not of the inferred list inside - a client that reinferred (joined mid-round) dropped another item than the server. A bot's is_bot is set before its saved items come back at the round start, so its back weapons get the bot filters on the server too (they snagged on walls until the next transfer, and a reinferring client computed other filters). Spare magazines of a bought weapon come after the weapon is carried - before that they counted as useless ammo and pushed each other out. A stack (shotgun shells) is bought and made room for whole - a part of it was left on the ground. A red purchase keeps room for what the hands hold, so the bought item itself never falls out right after; ammo held while reloading needs no room. The old magazine of a reload never pushes anything out of a full deposit - it falls to the ground as before. The server refuses a second armor, backpack or defuse kit, like the shop. Dedup: the oldest weapon on the back, wears_backpack, is_ammo_like; dead HANDS buy option removed.
